nufit.source: NuFIT 6.1 (2025), IC24 with Super-Kamiokande atmospheric data

juno_forecast_6y.source: JUNO six-year forecast, CPC 46 (2022) 123001, Table 6; centered on JUNO 2026 measured values (illustrative)

experimental_oval_definition: 2D independent-error Gaussian approximations: NuFIT 6.1 (NO) 68.27% / 99.73% (Delta chi2=2.30 / 11.83), JUNO 2026 measured solar 68.27% ellipse or optional six-year projection. NO covariance measurements supplied; NOT official joint contours.
model_oval_definition: default: 2x sample covariance standard-deviation radius about gamma=1 for all off-centre T1/T2/T3 points; descriptive, NOT a statistical confidence region; near-rank-one ovals not enlarged
physics_scope: saved conditional general-Lagrangian candidate UV/EFT1 + one-scale C5, NOT certified all-fermions-first then all-scalars sequential EFT matching
detail_coordinates: (observable(gamma)-observable(gamma=1))/10**power; power chosen separately for each panel and observable; experimental overview remains in absolute coordinates
juno_solar_chi2_definition: two marginal Gaussian residuals, diagonal; NOT official JUNO likelihood or combined global chi2
local_slope_definition: central difference dO/dln(gamma) using nearest gamma pair straddling 1; 1% change approximated linearly
